race.description: Mcgrath Estate Agents Ballan - Emerging Stars Series Heat 6
race.comment: SCOOT (12) battled away nicely at her first go around Mornington. This will likely be a tiny bit tougher but was in the market there. Probably tries to go forward and take up a position over the slightly longer distance for this. LEI (9) was supported a couple of times in her most recent preparation. She may have gotten back too far and that may occur again. At least she has had three trials to be ready. MAGNA SENTENTIA (5) has not been far away twice now and from there gets the blinkers for this. That may allow her to race much closer. Could easily make a big difference. RUN RUN WIN (7) missed narrowly on debut at Sale. Less effective last time at Cranbourne when getting too far back, but gets the blinkers on now and is drawn much better. Expecting him to play a more significant role.
